items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Then with trumpet I had John Coles who is now with Duke Ellington... he'll be playing with me for New Year's Day anyway.

ctx.x: You're right. And that's Trevor, he's a fine baritone and soprano player. Then with trumpet I had John Coles who is now with Duke Ellington and I just got a card from him saying that he has two weeks off starting on I think the 19th, if it was the 18th maybe he could come and play, but he'll be playing with me for New Year's Day anyway.
Oh where are you playing New Year's Day?
